array.string: set -a; [ -f "$HOME/.config/context-hub/env" ] && source "$HOME/.config/context-hub/env"; set +a; : "${CONTEXT_HUB_REPO:?set CONTEXT_HUB_REPO in ~/.config/context-hub/env}"; mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/Logs/context-hub"; exec >>"$HOME/Library/Logs/context-hub/stdout.log" 2>>"$HOME/Library/Logs/context-hub/stderr.log"; NODE_BIN="${CONTEXT_HUB_NODE_BIN:-$(command -v node || true)}"; if [ -z "$NODE_BIN" ] || [ ! -x "$NODE_BIN" ]; then echo "context-hub: node not found; set CONTEXT_HUB_NODE_BIN in ~/.config/context-hub/env"; exit 127; fi; cd "$CONTEXT_HUB_REPO" || exit 1; exec "$NODE_BIN" --experimental-strip-types "$CONTEXT_HUB_REPO/context-hub/src/serve.ts"
